name: BATNA and Negotiation Preparation
description: Can identify and strengthen a BATNA before any negotiation, set strategic anchors, and prepare using interest-based frameworks to achieve better outcomes.

name: Tactical Deal-Making and Closing
description: Demonstrates ability to apply tactical empathy, counter high-pressure tactics, navigate salary and contract negotiations, and close deals across complex multi-party situations.

name: Executive Presence and Structured Communication
description: Can project executive presence in meetings and presentations, apply the Pyramid Principle to structure any communication, and write clear, action-oriented recommendations.

name: Data Storytelling and High-Stakes Presenting
description: Demonstrates ability to turn data into compelling narratives using the right chart types, deliver polished presentations to boards and C-suites, and handle tough questions with confidence.

name: Technical Writing Fundamentals
description: Can write clear, audience-centered technical content — applying core principles of clarity and structure, analysing reader needs, and planning documents before writing.

name: API and Developer Documentation
description: Demonstrates ability to write complete API reference documentation, getting-started guides, and OpenAPI specifications that reduce developer integration friction.

name: LinkedIn Profile and Brand Foundation
description: Can build a compelling LinkedIn profile with a standout headline, keyword-rich About section, and featured content that reflects a clear personal brand and attracts the right opportunities.

name: LinkedIn Content and Thought Leadership
description: Demonstrates ability to create a consistent LinkedIn content strategy, write engaging posts with effective hooks, and build thought leadership that grows a professional audience.
